correctness.rationale: Finite connected absorbing chain with unique rational backwards solution; 30-state and independent 22-state lumped exact calculations verify singleton fractions at fitness 1, 3/2, 2. originality.rationale: Compared implication-level statements: ordinary graph regime reversals already exist (2018 and 2024) but their one-neighbor update does not cover full-copying mixed hypergraphs; the motivating 2023 hypergraph paper does not state this exact mixed 5-node result. Actual relevant sections of the three primary full texts were inspected, and broad and exact research-record/literature queries were conducted. Residual unindexed equivalence remains possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently formulated treatment of the exact mixed-size hypergraph may exist.
Graph results establish regime transitions in different models, so no claim of the first such transition in general evolutionary dynamics is made.

value.rationale: An explicit compact biologically interpretable mixed dyadic/triadic contact population reverses selection sign as fitness changes, while the motivating 2023 hypergraph study reported suppressors among its examined families. A nonroutine sharp weak-selection derivative plus exact finite-fitness sign comparisons identify a meaningful boundary of broad suppression extrapolation; not an arbitrary parameter-only numerical observation.
